description: Persuasion experts wield words as powerful tools, swaying hearts and minds with precision. They captivate audiences, negotiate high-stakes deals, and turn the tide of events without drawing a weapon. Through charm, intimidation, or carefully crafted rhetoric, they move mountains with mere words.

expertise.name: Deception
expertise.description: With your quick thinking and silver tongue, you effortlessly spin convincing tales and half-truths, manipulating others' perceptions to suit your needs.
options: Spend 1 Focus to tell a convincing white lie.
Spend 2 Focus to create a complex false narrative.
Spend 4 Focus to plant believable misinformation.

expertise.name: Diplomacy
expertise.description: Your keen understanding of social dynamics and emotional intelligence allows you to forge alliances, bridge divides, and find common ground in even the most challenging situations.
options: Spend 1 Focus to read a person’s emotions.
Spend 2 Focus to find a person’s motives.
Spend 4 Focus to form an alliance with a non-hostile person.

expertise.name: Entertainment
expertise.description: You captivate audiences with your mesmerizing performances, leaving them spellbound and craving more.
options: Spend 1 Focus to draw a crowd's attention.
Spend 2 Focus to evoke a specific emotion in your audience (e.g., laughter, awe, nostalgia).
Spend 4 Focus to deliver a memorable performance that achieves a specific goal.

expertise.name: Intimidation
expertise.description: Your commanding presence and unwavering resolve strike fear into the hearts of your enemies, making them think twice before crossing you.
options: Spend 1 Focus to make a target uneasy.
Spend 2 Focus to frighten a target.
Spend 4 Focus to terrify a target.

expertise.name: Motivation
expertise.description: You have a gift for inspiring others, igniting their passions and driving them to achieve the impossible through your words and actions.
options: Spend 1 Focus to inspire an individual to action.
Spend 2 Focus to boost a group's morale.
Spend 4 Focus to instill courage in the face of adversity.

expertise.name: Negotiation
expertise.description: With your sharp wit and persuasive skills, you navigate complex deals and contracts, always securing the best terms for yourself and your allies.
options: Spend 1 Focus to get a favorable price when buying or selling an item.
Spend 2 Focus to negotiate better terms in a deal or contract.
Spend 4 Focus to mediate a conflict between two parties.

expertise.name: Rhetoric
expertise.description: Your mastery of language and ability to craft compelling arguments make you a formidable force in any debate or public forum, swaying opinions and rallying support to your cause.
options: Spend 1 Focus to make a persuasive argument.
Spend 2 Focus to sway a small group's opinion.
Spend 4 Focus to deliver a rousing speech to a large audience.

expertise.name: Seduction
expertise.description: Your alluring charm and magnetic presence make you irresistible, allowing you to effortlessly win others' affection and trust.
options: Spend 1 Focus to distract a person.
Spend 2 Focus to gain a person’s trust.
Spend 4 Focus to convince a non-hostile person to do something within its means.
